from sympy import MatrixSymbol, ZeroMatrix
from sympy.matrices.expressions.blockmatrix import BlockMatrix, block_collapse

# square case from issue
A = MatrixSymbol('a', 2, 2)
Z = ZeroMatrix(2, 2)
B = BlockMatrix([[A, Z], [Z, Z]])
print('Block types after one mul:', type(B._blockmul(B).blocks[0,1]).__name__)
print(block_collapse(B*B*B))

# rectangular inner dimensions
m,n,p = 2,3,4
X = MatrixSymbol('X', m, n)
Y = MatrixSymbol('Y', n, p)
Zmn = ZeroMatrix(m, n)
Znp = ZeroMatrix(n, p)
Zmp = ZeroMatrix(m, p)
BM1 = BlockMatrix([[X, Zmp], [Zmn, Zmn]])  # shape (m+m) x (n+p)
BM2 = BlockMatrix([[Y],[Znp]])              # shape (n+p) x p
prod = block_collapse(BM1*BM2)
print('prod blockshape:', prod.blockshape)
print('prod rowblocksizes:', prod.rowblocksizes)
print('prod colblocksizes:', prod.colblocksizes)
print('prod blocks types:', type(prod.blocks[0,0]).__name__, type(prod.blocks[1,0]).__name__)
# chain again
prod2 = block_collapse(BlockMatrix([[prod]])*BlockMatrix([[BlockMatrix([[Y]])]]))
print('prod2 ok')

print('Done')
